summary: Tested AEDIFICA marketing site end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 8 requested bug fixes/features verified: hero eyebrow (no Est. 2024), coord +89°15' in hero/footer, no D avatar, aedifica.com domain (contact + footer), Reach links on separate lines, starfield canvas behind CTA+Contact, services 01-05 all rendered with well-spaced deliverable bullets (7/10/9/8/7), compass-star logo image loads (HTTP 200, /aedifica-logo.png). Contact form validation (empty) shows error toast; full submission returns success toast and persists in Mongo (verified via GET /api/contact).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') — should migrate to FastAPI lifespan handler (non-blocking, minor).
GET /api/contact is public and exposes all contact submissions with emails — consider auth-gating this admin endpoint for production.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ contact message inserted via backend test and one via Playwright submission; both persisted successfully.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend contact endpoints (POST/GET /api/contact) working. Playwright asserts nav-logo image src=/aedifica-logo.png (returns 200). All data-testids in review request are present and functional.
